name: tpl-chain-response-3-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Carry the box to the exit' is exactly Existence(at_exit) hard plus Response(at_exit, holding_box) hard (at_exit holds only on the last step, so the Response requires the box in hand at the exit, as the task demands). 'If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move' is exactly ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) hard, with the right argument order (box_fell as trigger, holding_box on the very next step), and the environment's own trace (fall at step 21, pickup at step 22) shows it is satisfiable; box_fell can never occur on the episode's final step, so no last-step trigger is left unsatisfiable. All three clauses trace to task sentences, all are hard as worded, no Existence(holding_box) lets the box be held anywhere, and no redundant or added clause appears; the clues confirm at_exit and holding_box are the only finishing requirements.

texts: Hold the box when reaching the exit.
If the box falls, pick it up again on the very next step.
